caseStudy.blurb: I served as visual and UX designer for Agility Robotics' rebrand website, collaborating with the brand director, development partner Upstatement, and the chief business officer to translate the new brand identity into a fully realized digital experience. Working within a condensed, parallel-build timeline, I drove the visual and interaction design that established the look, feel, and design system of Agility's public-facing web presence.
